evidence.note: Cush fathered Nimrod. The following הוּא introduces the description of Nimrod’s might.
The saying names Nimrod and repeats the description of him as a mighty hunter before Yahweh.

name: נִמְרֹד
summary: Genesis names Nimrod as a son of Cush and says that he became a mighty man on earth. His reputation as a mighty hunter before Yahweh gave rise to the saying “like Nimrod.”
